name: seatplanning
description: Work out how many tables your event needs. Tell ChatGPT your guest count and table style, and SeatPlanning shows how many tables you need, how many seats each one holds, how many seats are left empty, and whether they fit in your room, with a floor-plan preview.

interface.longDescription:
Planning a wedding, party, gala or fundraiser? SeatPlanning works out your table layout in seconds, right inside the chat.

Tell ChatGPT how many guests are coming and what kind of tables your venue uses (round or rectangular). SeatPlanning replies with:

- How many tables you need
- How many guests sit at each table
- How many seats will be left empty
- Whether the tables fit in your room, if you tell it the room size
- A simple floor-plan preview you can see at a glance

You can ask follow-up questions in plain language, such as "what if I use bigger tables?" or "what if I only seat 8 per table?", and compare the answers.

When you are happy with the numbers, you get a link to the SeatPlanning table calculator with your answers already filled in, so you can adjust them further.

No account is needed, and SeatPlanning does not store what you type. It only looks things up and never changes anything.
defaultPrompt: How many round tables do I need for 120 wedding guests?
Will 80 guests fit at 6-foot rectangular tables in a 40 by 60 ft room?
Compare 60-inch and 72-inch round tables for 150 guests.

positive.prompt: I have 120 guests at my wedding. How many 72-inch round tables do I need if each seats 10?
positive.expected_behavior: 12 tables of 10, 0 empty seats, floor-plan preview and calculator link.

positive.description: Empty seats with the default table.
positive.prompt: We are expecting 95 guests with 60-inch round tables. How many tables and how many empty chairs?
positive.expected_behavior: 12 tables of 8, 1 empty seat, preview shown.

positive.prompt: Will 80 guests fit at 6-foot rectangular tables in a room 40 ft by 60 ft?
positive.expected_behavior: 14 tables of 6, 4 empty seats, verdict: fits comfortably in 40 x 60 ft.

positive.prompt: I want only 8 guests per table for 150 guests, using 72-inch round tables.
Compare 8-foot rectangular tables and 60-inch round tables for 100 guests.
positive.expected_behavior: Two calls: 13 rectangular tables of 8 and 13 round tables of 8, each with 4 empty seats, compared side by side.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris this weekend?
Write a wedding toast for my sister.
Seat 12 guests at each 36-inch round table for 50 guests.
negative.expected_behavior: Tool returns an error that a 36-inch round seats 4 to 6; ChatGPT explains and suggests a valid option.
